contract.timeScope: Proof execution only: witness generation, commitments, composition, FRI, proof of work and finishing, summed over every Cairo, wrap and fold proof in a job. Loading, setup, publication and verification are excluded.
contract.memoryScope: Peak memory must fit the host; it is a capacity gate, never part of the score.

tracks.name: Proof time
tracks.objective: Fastest proof execution across the Cairo, fold and pipeline jobs.
tracks.why: Proof execution is the work every prover pays for, whatever the surrounding service does.

families.name: Cairo proofs
families.description: Standalone Cairo proofs of single- and multi-block Starknet PIEs, chosen to stress different builtins. Only the Cairo prover-call interval is scored.

families.name: Fold proofs
families.description: Canonical multiverifier folds over distinct, already wrapped and verified circuit leaves. Only fold prover-call intervals are scored.

families.name: Cairo → wrap → fold
families.description: Adapted PIEs all the way to one recursive root: every Cairo proof, every wrap and every fold, in one case.
families.explainer: Prove each PIE, wrap each Cairo proof into a leaf, then fold leaves into one root. Every prover-call interval counts; loading, setup, publication and verification are reported separately.
families.inputs: Two or more consecutive PIEs whose state roots chain from one block range to the next.

cases.title: Range-check 96 + mod
cases.description: One-block range-check-96 and modular arithmetic outlier.

cases.title: Four-block mix
cases.description: Four contiguous blocks with a high step count.

cases.title: Near capacity
cases.description: One-block, EC-heavy, close to the device memory ceiling.

cases.title: Two-leaf fold
cases.description: One fold proof over two distinct, already wrapped circuit leaves.

cases.title: Eight-leaf tree
cases.description: Seven fold proofs over eight state-continuous ten-block mainnet leaves.

cases.title: Two leaves to a root
cases.description: Two Cairo proofs, two wraps and one fold, ending in a single recursive root.

tiers.name: Intake
tiers.description: Patch paths, file types, size and base commit are checked without running candidate code. Under a minute.

tiers.name: Smoke
tiers.description: A trusted worker rebuilds from source, runs focused tests, then one PIE and one recursion case with independent verification.

tiers.name: Qualify
tiers.description: The public basket plus a private holdout, once each, with exact security and output gates.

tiers.name: Rank
tiers.description: Fresh A/A calibration and at least three paired ABBA rounds of proof execution time. Capacity and exact verification are gates; the trusted receipt is signed.

participate.title: Set up the proof epoch
participate.body: Creates the pinned baseline and editable source for this backend and checks the protected timer files.

participate.title: Edit the backend
participate.body: Change only this backend's editable paths in workspace/proof-v2-source. Timer-owning files are fixed and hash-checked.

participate.title: Capture the patch
participate.body: Writes candidate/proof-v2-changes.patch and validates the backend's edit surface.

participate.title: Check the contract
participate.body: Validates the patch against the staged proof-only contract before asking for a judged run.

rules: Only proof execution is timed: Cairo, wrap and fold proof intervals, summed per job.
Every job must reproduce its exact reference proof or root and pass independent verification.
No proof may be skipped, cached from an earlier request, or moved outside the recorded intervals.
Timer-owning files are protected; a candidate cannot edit, forge or truncate them.
Each backend is scored only against its own pinned baseline on the same host.
Memory is a capacity gate: a job that does not fit fails qualification.

stages.name: Cairo proof
stages.summary: Proves an adapted Starknet PIE with the Stwo Cairo AIR on the selected backend.
stages.explainer: The base proof. The Stwo prover runs the Cairo AIR over the execution trace in a PIE and produces a STARK proof that the Starknet OS executed those blocks correctly: every memory access, builtin call and state transition. It is by far the largest proof here, and where most proving time goes.
stages.inputs: A PIE (Position Independent Execution) is the complete execution record the Starknet OS produces when it runs one or more consecutive blocks: memory, builtin segments and the program's public output, relocatable so it can be proved anywhere. It is adapted into a compact prover input (CPI) before timing starts.

stages.name: Wrap
stages.summary: Proves, inside a circuit, that a Cairo proof verifies. The result is a uniform circuit leaf that recursion can consume.
stages.explainer: A recursion step. A circuit proof attests that the Cairo proof verifies, and re-expresses it in the uniform shape that folding understands, whatever the original PIE looked like.
stages.inputs: One Cairo proof and its public statement (the blocks and outputs it covers).

stages.name: Fold
stages.summary: One canonical multiverifier proof that verifies two child proofs. Folds repeat until a single root remains.
stages.explainer: A multiverifier circuit proof that verifies two child proofs at once and binds their ordered outputs, so state continuity across blocks is preserved. Folds repeat pairwise until a single root proof covers every leaf.
stages.inputs: Two circuit proofs: wrapped leaves, or the results of earlier folds.

backends.name: Stwo CUDA
backends.headline: Prove Starknet faster on one H200.
backends.summary: Cut the time the CUDA prover spends proving: Cairo proofs of Starknet blocks, the wraps that turn them into circuit leaves, and the folds that reduce leaves to one root. Only proof execution is scored.

backends.name: Stwo Metal
backends.headline: Prove Starknet faster on Apple silicon.
backends.summary: The same nine proof jobs on the Metal backend of an M5 Max: Cairo proofs, wraps and folds over shared, hash-pinned inputs. Only proof execution is scored, against Metal's own baseline.

backends.name: Stwo CPU
backends.headline: Prove Starknet faster on the CPU.
backends.summary: The same nine proof jobs on the CPU backend of an M5 Max: Cairo proofs, wraps and folds over shared, hash-pinned inputs. Only proof execution is scored, against the CPU's own baseline.
